query: I added a nullable `notes` column to the recipients table. Set up the migration for that.
expected_behavior: Creates a migration via bun run db:revision -- "<description>" rather than hand-writing an alembic file from scratch
Does NOT run bun run db:upgrade against the user's database without being explicitly asked
Includes or describes a rollback path (the downgrade side of the migration), not just the upgrade
Treats the migration as high-risk, with a tested rollback and a blast-radius note, rather than as a routine low-risk edit
Runs or instructs to run bun run db:check-destructive and the relevant backend tests
Does not silently skip recording an ADR if the change reflects a real data-model decision worth capturing
